title: Call a REST API: Python, JavaScript, Java & Go Examples
title_es: Llamar a una API REST: Python, JS, Java y Go
description: Runnable HTTP client examples in Python (requests), JavaScript (fetch), Java (HttpClient), and Go (net/http) with GET, POST, auth, timeouts, and error handling.
description_es: Ejemplos runnable de clientes HTTP en Python (requests), JavaScript (fetch), Java (HttpClient) y Go (net/http) con GET, POST, auth, timeouts y manejo de errores.
